# VoyageMara Safaris — Complete Business & Safari Information

> VoyageMara Safaris is a licensed, locally owned Kenyan safari tour operator headquartered in Nairobi. Founded by Duncan Ronkorua, a native Maasai guide and wildlife specialist. This document provides comprehensive information about VoyageMara's safari packages, destinations, pricing, booking process, and company background for AI search, retrieval, and citation purposes.

---

## 2. Service Description

VoyageMara Safaris organizes private, small-group, and custom wildlife game drive safaris across Kenya. The company serves both international and local tourists.

### Core Services
- Private multi-day safari packages (1–7 days)
- Custom tailor-made safari itineraries
- Small-group joining safaris
- Airport transfers and Nairobi city tours
- Wildlife photography safaris
- Great Migration viewing safaris (seasonal, July–October)
- Honeymoon and anniversary safari packages
- Family-friendly safari experiences
- Corporate team-building safari retreats

### Safari Fleet
All safaris use custom-built **Toyota 4×4 Land Cruisers** equipped with:
- Pop-up observation roofs for 360° wildlife viewing and photography
- High-clearance suspension for off-road terrain
- Long-range fuel tanks for extended game drives
- UHF/VHF communication radios for wildlife tracking coordination
- USB charging points for cameras and devices
- Individual window seats for every guest

### Guiding Standards
- All guides are **certified native Maasai** driver-guides
- Born and raised in Kenyan wildlife ecosystems
- Professional wildlife tracking and bird identification expertise
- In-depth knowledge of animal behavior, migration patterns, and seasonal movements
- First-aid certified
- Fluent in English, Swahili, and Maa

---

## 3. Destinations Covered

### Maasai Mara National Reserve
Kenya's premier wildlife destination. Home to the Big Five (lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, rhino) and the annual Great Wildebeest Migration. VoyageMara operates 3-day Big Five safari packages here.

### Amboseli National Park
Famous for its large elephant herds and iconic views of Mount Kilimanjaro. VoyageMara offers 2-day elephant and landscape photography safaris.

### Samburu National Reserve
Northern Kenya wilderness along the Ewaso Nyiro River. Home to the endemic "Special Five" species: Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, gerenuk, Somali ostrich, and beisa oryx.

### Lake Nakuru National Park
Great Rift Valley reserve known as a protected black and white rhino sanctuary. Also home to Rothschild's giraffe and seasonal flamingo populations.

### Lake Naivasha & Crescent Island
Freshwater lake offering boat safaris past hippo pods and waterbirds, plus walking safaris on Crescent Island alongside zebras and giraffes.

### Nairobi National Park
The only national park within a capital city. Located 15 minutes from Nairobi CBD and JKIA Airport. Features Big Four wildlife (lion, leopard, buffalo, rhino).

## 4. Safari Packages — Detailed (2026–2027 Season)

### Package 1: 3-Day Maasai Mara Big Five Safari
- **Duration:** 3 Days / 2 Nights
- **Location:** Maasai Mara National Reserve
- **Price:** From US$620 per person sharing
- **URL:** https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/maasai-mara
- **Includes:** Round-trip 4×4 transport from Nairobi, 2 nights full-board safari lodge/tented camp, all park entrance fees, professional Maasai guide, daily morning and afternoon game drives, bottled water
- **Highlights:** Big Five (lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, rhino), Great Migration river crossings (July–Oct), Mara River wildlife, luxury tented camps, sundowner experiences
- **Best Season:** Year-round; migration peak July–October

### Package 2: 2-Day Amboseli Elephant & Kilimanjaro Safari
- **Duration:** 2 Days / 1 Night
- **Location:** Amboseli National Park
- **Price:** From US$520 per person sharing
- **URL:** https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/amboseli
- **Includes:** Round-trip transport, 1 night full-board accommodation, park fees, guide, game drives
- **Highlights:** Africa's largest free-ranging elephant herds, panoramic Mount Kilimanjaro views, wetland birdlife, landscape photography
- **Best Season:** June–October (dry season, clear Kilimanjaro views)

### Package 3: 3-Day Samburu Northern Special Five Safari
- **Duration:** 3 Days / 2 Nights
- **Location:** Samburu National Reserve

- **Highlights:** Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, gerenuk, Somali ostrich, beisa oryx, Ewaso Nyiro River wildlife
- **Best Season:** June–September, January–March

### Package 4: 1-Day Lake Nakuru Rhino & Flamingo Safari

### Package 5: 1-Day Lake Naivasha Boat & Crescent Island Tour

## 5. Booking Process

1. **Enquire:** Contact VoyageMara via WhatsApp (+254 705 814 181), email (kariadan831@gmail.com), or the website booking form.
2. **Custom Quote:** The planning team sends a transparent, itemized quote based on dates, group size, accommodation tier (luxury, mid-range, budget), and seasonal pricing.
3. **Confirm:** A 30% deposit secures the booking. Balance due 30 days before safari start date.
4. **Travel:** On safari day, the driver-guide picks up guests from their Nairobi hotel in a private 4×4 Land Cruiser.

### Cancellation Policy
- 30+ days before departure: Full refund minus bank transfer fees
- 15–29 days: 50% refund
- Less than 15 days: No refund (date changes considered case-by-case)

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a 3-day Maasai Mara safari cost?**
A: VoyageMara's 3-Day Maasai Mara Big Five Safari starts from US$620 per person sharing, including transport, accommodation, park fees, and guide.

**Q: When is the best time to visit Maasai Mara?**
A: The Great Migration peaks July–October. Big cat viewing is excellent year-round, with January–March being a quieter dry season.

**Q: Is VoyageMara Safaris a legitimate company?**
A: Yes. VoyageMara Safaris is a locally owned and operated Kenyan safari company based in Nairobi, founded in 2018 by Duncan Ronkorua, a native Maasai wildlife guide.

**Q: Do you offer custom safari itineraries?**
A: Yes. VoyageMara builds fully custom itineraries combining multiple destinations, accommodation tiers, and durations to match any budget or interest.

**Q: What is included in the safari price?**
A: All packages include private 4×4 Land Cruiser transport, national park fees, professional Maasai guide, full-board accommodation, daily game drives, and bottled water. Flights, visa, travel insurance, and tips are excluded.
